entries.0f20ecb149844e60: It manufactures and sells large automated cell culture systems for drug discovery screening, such as 'CellMeister®', the successor model 'MakCell®' to its automated cell culture system specialized for iPS cells, and equipment related to its proprietary three-dimensional rotary floating culture technology 'CELLFLOAT®'.
entries.27e1706ff024d2d7: This business manufactures life science equipment, such as automated culture devices for various cells including iPS cells, and equipment that processes the surfaces of wafers for semiconductor devices at the nanometer and atomic levels. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥284 million.
entries.50d4eb54400ee189: Based on Osaka University's proprietary processing technology, it develops and manufactures processing equipment used for surface finishing and polishing of various wafers that serve as substrates for semiconductor devices and electronic components. In addition to plasma chemical vaporization machining (PCVM) for quartz crystal wafers, it is advancing the commercialization of plasma-assisted polishing (PAP) for diamond wafers, catalyst-referred etching (CARE) for LT/LN and GaN wafers, and electrochemical mechanical polishing (ECMP) for SiC wafers. No amount is given because it is not disclosed separately.

entries.5bd87cc0e3319fcf: A company headquartered in Ibaraki, Osaka Prefecture, that develops and manufactures X-ray nano-focusing mirrors for synchrotron radiation facilities, automated cell culture systems, wafer surface processing equipment, and other products.
entries.5daee48c6cc824d2: This business designs, custom-makes and sells ultra-high-precision X-ray mirrors with reflective surface shape accuracy of 1 nanometer or less, for use at synchrotron radiation facilities and X-ray free-electron laser facilities in Japan and overseas, tailored to users' specifications.
entries.7c16bfe6cba94ad7: This business designs, custom-makes and sells ultra-high-precision X-ray mirrors with reflective surface shape accuracy of 1 nanometer or less, for use at synchrotron radiation facilities and X-ray free-electron laser facilities in Japan and overseas, tailored to users' specifications. Centered on the X-ray nano-focusing mirror 'OsakaMirror', commercialized based on research results from Osaka University and RIKEN, it handles focusing mirrors, harmonic cut mirrors, diffraction grating substrates and others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥1,426 million.
entries.7eb7905b9a8bf0e5: This business is run by consolidated subsidiary Denshi Kagaku Co., Ltd., which manufactures and sells thermal desorption spectrometers (TDS).
entries.a7cf10a77c5bfaa9: This business is run by consolidated subsidiary Denshi Kagaku Co., Ltd., which manufactures and sells thermal desorption spectrometers (TDS). The equipment heats a sample placed in an ultra-high vacuum environment and detects trace components released from it by mass spectrometry; it is used for materials research on semiconductors, liquid crystals and other materials, and for evaluation and quality control in manufacturing processes. It also provides equipment maintenance and contract analysis services. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥244 million.
